test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vicious
solution:
The correct answer is **"Gentle"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Here let's see the given word meanings:

__
 
• **Vicious - **cruel; done in order to hurt somebody/something

 
 
• ***Eg.*** The robber made a* vicious* attack 
 
 
 
• **Gentle - **(used about people) kind and calm; touching or treating people or things in a careful way so that they are not hurt
 
 
• ***Eg.*** I'll try and be as *gentle* as I can,’ said the dentist.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's learn some new word meanings:

 
• **Influential -** having power or influence

 
 
• ***Eg. ***He was an* influential* leader. 
 
 
 
• **Privileged -** having an advantage or opportunity that most people do not have
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Only a *privileged* few are allowed to enter this room.
 
 
 
• **Poor -** not having enough money to have a comfortable life
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The family was too *poor* to buy new clothes.
